audio.t: Attention, passengers traveling to Nantes on the 14:20 regional train. Due to maintenance work on the tracks, this train will depart from platform 9 instead of platform 4. Please note that the first two carriages will not be in service today, so passengers with reservations in those carriages may sit anywhere in carriages three to six. A refreshment cart will be available on board. We apologize for any inconvenience.

questions.prompt: What has changed for the 14:20 train?
questions.evidence: this train will depart from platform 9 instead of platform 4
questions.explanation: Le train part du quai 9 au lieu du quai 4.

questions.prompt: What are some passengers told they may do?
options: Sit in a different part of the train
questions.evidence: may sit anywhere in carriages three to six
questions.explanation: Les passagers des voitures 1 et 2 peuvent s'asseoir n'importe où dans les voitures 3 à 6.

questions.prompt: What will be available on the train?
questions.evidence: A refreshment cart will be available on board.
questions.explanation: Un chariot de restauration (boissons et en-cas) passera à bord.

audio.t: Need to improve your English for work but can't find the time? At Lingua Pro, our evening classes start at seven P.M. and last just ninety minutes, so you can join us straight from the office. All our teachers are certified and have experience in business environments. Sign up before the end of the month and your first week of classes is free. Plus, students who complete the full course receive a certificate recognized by more than two hundred employers. Visit linguapro.com to take our free online level test.

questions.prompt: What is being advertised?
questions.evidence: improve your English for work
questions.explanation: La publicité présente des cours d'anglais du soir : une école de langues.
questions.takeaway: Le produit est présenté dans les deux premières phrases.

questions.prompt: Who is the advertisement mainly intended for?
questions.evidence: you can join us straight from the office
questions.explanation: Cours du soir, après le bureau, anglais professionnel : la cible est les actifs.
questions.takeaway: Straight from the office = directement en sortant du bureau.

questions.prompt: How can listeners receive free classes?
questions.evidence: Sign up before the end of the month and your first week of classes is free
questions.explanation: La première semaine est offerte pour une inscription avant la fin du mois.
questions.traps: Le test en ligne est gratuit mais ne donne pas de cours gratuits.
questions.takeaway: Before the end of the month = avant une date limite.

audio.t: Good morning, everyone. As you've probably seen, our online sales grew by fifteen percent this quarter, mainly thanks to the new mobile app. In-store sales, however, dropped slightly. Now, I know what some of you are thinking. But we're not planning to close any stores. Instead, we'll add pickup counters so customers can collect their online orders in our shops. We'll start with three pilot locations in March, and I'd like each store manager to tell me by Friday whether their store has enough space.

questions.prompt: According to the speaker, what caused the increase in online sales?
questions.evidence: mainly thanks to the new mobile app
questions.explanation: La hausse vient surtout de la nouvelle application mobile.

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker say, "I know what some of you are thinking"?
options: To address a concern about store closures
To announce a change in management
questions.evidence: I know what some of you are thinking.
questions.explanation: Après l'annonce de la baisse des ventes en magasin, elle anticipe une inquiétude et précise aussitôt qu'aucune fermeture n'est prévue.
questions.takeaway: La phrase qui suit l'expression révèle l'inquiétude visée.

questions.prompt: What are store managers asked to do?
questions.evidence: whether their store has enough space
questions.explanation: Chaque responsable doit indiquer d'ici vendredi si son magasin a assez de place pour un comptoir de retrait.

audio.t: Welcome to the old harbor district walking tour. Over the next ninety minutes, we'll visit five buildings that date back to the seventeenth century, including the former customs house, which is now the city's maritime library. The streets here are paved with uneven stones, so please watch your step. Halfway through, we'll stop at a café where you can buy refreshments. And if you enjoy today's tour, I'd recommend our evening boat trip, which leaves from this very spot at eight.

questions.prompt: Who most likely is the speaker?
questions.evidence: Welcome to the old harbor district walking tour.
questions.explanation: Il accueille un groupe pour une visite à pied du quartier : c'est un guide.

questions.prompt: What does the speaker say about the former customs house?
questions.evidence: which is now the city's maritime library
questions.explanation: L'ancienne douane abrite aujourd'hui la bibliothèque maritime.
questions.takeaway: Former = ancien (qui a changé de fonction).

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker tell listeners to be careful?
questions.evidence: paved with uneven stones, so please watch your step
questions.explanation: Les pavés sont irréguliers : il faut regarder où l'on marche.
questions.takeaway: Watch your step = attention où vous marchez.

audio.t: Welcome back from lunch, everyone. Before we continue, one change to the afternoon agenda. Our product director's flight was delayed, so she won't arrive until about three thirty. We'll therefore swap her session with the coffee break, which means you'll get your break a bit earlier than planned. Everything else stays the same. Also, please remember to fill out the feedback form in your folder before you leave tonight; it really helps us plan next year's event.

questions.prompt: Why has the schedule been changed?
questions.evidence: Our product director's flight was delayed
questions.explanation: Le vol de la directrice produit a été retardé : elle arrivera vers 15 h 30.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. When will the coffee break now take place?
questions.explanation: On inverse la session « New Product Line » (14 h 30) et la pause (15 h 30) : la pause a donc lieu à 14 h 30.
questions.traps: 15 h 30 est l'horaire initial de la pause.
questions.takeaway: Swap = intervertir : applique l'échange au tableau.

questions.prompt: What are listeners asked to do before leaving?
questions.evidence: please remember to fill out the feedback form in your folder
questions.explanation: Ils doivent remplir le formulaire d'avis avant de partir.
questions.takeaway: Fill out a form = remplir un formulaire.

audio.t: Hello, Ms. Rossi, this is Victor from Brightline Packaging. I'm calling about your order of five thousand gift boxes. Our printer has run out of the gold ink you selected for your logo, and the next delivery won't arrive for two weeks. We could print the logo in silver instead and ship the order on schedule, or wait for the gold ink. I've e-mailed you a photo showing what the silver version would look like. Please let me know which option you prefer by Thursday so we can plan production.

questions.prompt: What problem does the speaker mention?
options: An order was sent to the wrong address.
A material is out of stock.
questions.evidence: Our printer has run out of the gold ink you selected
questions.explanation: L'imprimeur n'a plus d'encre dorée : une matière est en rupture.
questions.takeaway: Run out of = être à court de.

questions.prompt: What has the speaker sent to the listener?
questions.evidence: I've e-mailed you a photo showing what the silver version would look like
questions.explanation: Il a envoyé une photo de la version argentée : une image d'échantillon.

questions.prompt: What does the speaker ask the listener to do?
questions.evidence: Please let me know which option you prefer by Thursday
questions.explanation: Elle doit choisir entre l'argent maintenant ou l'or plus tard.

audio.t: In local news, the new pedestrian bridge connecting the business district to Riverside Park will open to the public on Saturday, three weeks ahead of schedule. The city says the bridge will cut walking time between the two areas from twenty minutes to just five. To celebrate the opening, local musicians will perform on the bridge from noon until four. City officials expect large crowds, so visitors are encouraged to take public transportation, as parking near the park will be limited.

questions.prompt: What is the news report mainly about?
questions.evidence: the new pedestrian bridge connecting the business district to Riverside Park will open
questions.explanation: Le reportage annonce l'ouverture d'une passerelle piétonne.

questions.prompt: What is mentioned about the project?
options: It was designed by local artists.
It will be open only on weekends.
questions.evidence: three weeks ahead of schedule
questions.explanation: La passerelle ouvre trois semaines en avance.

questions.prompt: Why are listeners advised to use public transportation?
options: The bridge is far from the city center.
questions.evidence: parking near the park will be limited
questions.explanation: Le stationnement près du parc sera limité, d'où le conseil de prendre les transports en commun.
questions.takeaway: Be encouraged to = être invité à.

audio.t: Thanks for coming to this session on our new customer database. I know many of you have used the old system for over ten years. Believe me, I did too. The new database will take a little getting used to, but it will save each of you about an hour a week on data entry. Today we'll cover the basics: searching for customer records and updating contact details. On Thursday, we'll look at the reporting tools. Please log in now using the temporary password on the card in front of you.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the session?
options: To train staff on new software
questions.evidence: this session on our new customer database
questions.explanation: La séance forme le personnel à la nouvelle base de données clients.

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker say, "Believe me, I did too"?
options: To explain why he is late
To complain about the old system
To show he understands the listeners' situation
questions.evidence: Believe me, I did too.
questions.explanation: Il rappelle qu'il a lui aussi utilisé l'ancien système pendant des années : il montre qu'il comprend la difficulté du changement.
questions.takeaway: Intention : créer de l'empathie avant d'annoncer un changement.

questions.prompt: What are listeners asked to do now?
questions.evidence: Please log in now using the temporary password
questions.explanation: Ils doivent se connecter avec le mot de passe temporaire.

audio.t: Hi Jonas, it's Mira. I've looked at the cleaning company's price list you forwarded me. Since we've moved to the larger office and now have thirty people, once a week isn't enough anymore. But daily cleaning seems excessive, and we can't spend more than six hundred euros a month. So please go ahead with the plan that gives us the most visits within that budget. Oh, and ask them whether window cleaning is included.

questions.prompt: Why does the company need a different cleaning plan?
options: It has moved to a bigger office.
It is hosting a client event.
questions.evidence: we've moved to the larger office and now have thirty people
questions.explanation: L'entreprise a emménagé dans un bureau plus grand avec 30 personnes.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which plan will Jonas most likely choose?
questions.explanation: Budget maximum 600 € et le plus de passages possible : la formule Plus (3 passages, 580 €). Premium (900 €) dépasse le budget.
questions.takeaway: « The most… within that budget » : maximum sous contrainte.

questions.prompt: What does the speaker want to know?
questions.evidence: ask them whether window cleaning is included
questions.explanation: Elle veut savoir si le nettoyage des vitres est compris.

sets.title: Discours de départ à la retraite

audio.t: Thank you all for being here to celebrate Margaret's retirement. Margaret joined us thirty-two years ago as a junior accountant, back when we had a single office and twelve employees. She went on to lead our finance department through three acquisitions. Many of you also know her as the person who started our mentoring program, which has helped more than two hundred new employees. Margaret, we have a small gift for you: a trip to Japan, which I hear you've wanted to take for years.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the speech?
questions.evidence: celebrate Margaret's retirement
questions.explanation: Le discours rend hommage à Margaret qui part à la retraite.

questions.prompt: What did Margaret create?
questions.evidence: the person who started our mentoring program
questions.explanation: Elle a lancé le programme de mentorat de l'entreprise.
questions.traps: Elle a dirigé le service financier, mais ne l'a pas créé.
questions.takeaway: Start a program = créer un programme.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about Margaret?
options: She has long wanted to visit Japan.
questions.evidence: which I hear you've wanted to take for years
questions.explanation: On lui offre un voyage au Japon qu'elle souhaite faire depuis des années.
